_comment: Every tunable the simulation reads. No balance number may be hardcoded in sim/. This file is designed to be server-delivered later, so a balance patch does not require a client update.
_effectiveness: Rows are damage types (kinetic, thermal, emp, corrosive); columns are armour types (plate, composite, reactive, shielded). Each damage type beats exactly one armour and is blunted by exactly one, so no single squad answers everything.
